description: Show a sample of Nuvidian P2's Today's 10 built from fictional people, so a human can see what the product does before signing up. Call it when someone asks 'what is P2?' or 'show me'. Each card is a fictional person with a plain-English reason to reach out today (overdue follow-up, a deal with no next step, a home anniversary, a new lead nobody has called, a stalled deal, a past client you have left alone). Read the cards out in order with their 'why' line, then read the note: it says the people are fake and how to start a free workspace. Nothing is written and nobody is contacted.
name: p2_practice_today
